matrix_convention: row-vector homogeneous; [x,y,z,1] @ matrix. Transpose for VTK column-vector convention.
mesh_points_convention: points_body_key arrays are full original vertices transformed into owning rigid-body local coordinates; do NOT apply local_to_body_matrix_row again.
analytic_shapes_convention: radius,height,size,axis retain original USD dimensions; generate analytic surface, then apply local_to_body_matrix_row exactly once.
capsule_definition: USD Capsule height is length of cylinder section, excluding hemispherical caps; axis is the USD local axis.
faces_convention: Original polygon topology, flat VTK-style [N0,indices...,N1,indices...]; no simplification.
material_convention: Constant source material values are retained, with color_source; no texture or spatial color is replaced silently.
visibility_policy: Exclude collision-named branches, inherited invisible geometry and guide-purpose geometry; no other geometry removal.
